heading: Sub-Section 2 Cheating
text:
Sub-Section 2 Cheating

Article 384: Cheating

Cheating is an act committed by a person who knows that it is absolutely impossible for him/her to pay or who is determined not to pay:
1.	to have someone served him/her foods or beverages in a bar, a restaurant or

any other establishment opened to the public;
2.	to have someone provided with and to occupy a room in a hotel or any other establishment opened to the public;
3.	to have someone driven him/her in a tricycle, in a taxi/bus or in any other means of transportation.

The cheating is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

Article 387: Improper biddings

SECTION 1 BREACH OF TRUST

Article 391: Definition of Breach of Trust

The breach of trust is an act committed to misappropriate, at the expenses of another person, funds, assets or any other property by a person who has been entrusted with and that he/she has accepted with a duty to return them, to present them or to make a specific use of them.

heading: Article 392: Penalties to be Imposed

heading: Article 393: Breach of Special Trust by a Governor or other Persons
text:
Article 393: Breach of Special Trust by a Governor or other Persons

All governors or supervisors of legal entities of corporation with limited responsibilities or funding legal entities or persons who are assigned by a court to act on its behalf, or employees who are authorized by a legal entity who breach the trust for their own benefit or the benefit of the third party or with the purpose of damaging the legal entity and resulting in damage of property of the legal entity are punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

Provisions of Paragraph 1 above is also applicable to the cases where liquidators of legal entities of corporation with limited responsibilities or funding legal entities or persons who are assigned by a court to act on behalf of the liquidators commit an act as mentioned in Paragraph 1 above and damage the properties of the legal entities.

The attempt to commit offences as mentioned Paragraphs 1 and 2 above is punished by the same penalties.

heading: CHAPTER 4 COMPLEMENTARY OFFENCES
text:
CHAPTER 4 COMPLEMENTARY OFFENCES

SECTION 1 RECEIVING STOLEN GOODS

Article 399: Receiving Stolen Goods

Receiving stolen goods is the act of concealing, holding or transmitting an object knowingly that this object derives from a felony or a misdemeanour.
The following acts also constitute receiving stolen goods:
1.	the act of serving as an intermediary in order to transmit an object knowingly that this object derived from a felony or a misdemeanour;
2.	the acts of benefiting, with full knowledge of the facts, from a felony or misdemeanour.

heading: Article 403
SECTION 2 MONEY LAUNDERING
text:
SECTION 2 MONEY LAUNDERING

Article 404: Definition of Money Laundering

Money laundering is an act of providing, by any means, the false justifications to conceal the direct or indirect benefits of a felony or a misdemeanour.

The act of lending support to further its operational transaction for investing, concealing or converting the direct or indirect benefits of a felony or a misdemeanour is also considered as money laundering.
translated_text:
SECTION 2 MONEY LAUNDERING

Money laundering is an act of providing, by any means, the false justifications to conceal the direct or indirect benefits of a felony or a misdemeanour.

The act of lending support to further its operational transaction for investing, concealing or converting the direct or indirect benefits of a felony or a misdemeanour is also considered as money laundering.

heading: Article 405: Penalties to be imposed
text:
Article 405: Penalties to be imposed

Money laundering is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels up to the value of funds, assets and properties which were the subject of money laundering.

In the event that the offences that were the source of assets or funds, and they were the subject of money laundering, which is punishable to an imprisonment which is longer than the imprisonment term mentioned in paragraph 1 above, the imprisonment

sentence shall be the same as the offence to the knowledge of the perpetrator and if the offence has several aggravating circumstances then the perpetrator shall be punished according to the circumstances he/she is aware of only.

text:
Article 414: Aggravating Circumstances due to Injuring Other Person

Article 415: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Maiming or Disability

text:

heading: Article 418: Acts that Result in Minor Damage
text:
Article 418: Acts that Result in Minor Damage

The intentional act to destroy, deteriorate or damage properties belonging to another person is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) day to 6 (six) days and a fine from 1,000 (one thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels, if this act has resulted in minor damage only.

The provisions of this article are not applied to public or private cultural properties that are parts of the Cambodian national heritage.

heading: Article 419: Other Damages due to Imprudence or Non-observance
text:
Article 419: Other Damages due to Imprudence or Non-observance

Destruction, deterioration or damage of properties belonging to another person by means of an explosive or setting fire is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels, when it is resulted:
1.	by an imprudence, an inattention or a negligence;
2.	by a violation of obligation, a security or the legally imposed prudence.

heading: Article 420: Damaging Posters or Official Notice

Article 420: Damaging Posters or Official Notice

Intentional acts to destroy, deteriorate or damage an official poster or an official notice of the administrative bodies is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) day to 6 (six) days and a fine from 1,000 (one thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 423: Threats to Damage
text:
Article 423: Threats to Damage

Threats to commit destruction, deterioration or damage is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels if it was repeated again and again or if this threat was done by writing, by a sketch or by any other object.

If the properties which are the subject of threats to commit destruction, deterioration or damage have little value, the monetary fine from 5,000 (five thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels is imposed.

heading: Article 424: Threats to Commit Destruction Followed by an Order
text:
Article 424: Threats to Commit Destruction Followed by an Order

heading: Article 425: Falsification of Information
text:
Article 425: Falsification of Information

heading: Article 427: Accessing or Maintaining Access to Automated Data Processing Systems
text:
Article 427: Accessing or Maintaining Access to Automated Data Processing Systems

The acts of fraudulently having access to a system of automated data processing or maintaining access to it, is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.

When the act has resulted in either deletion or modification of the data contained in the system, or an alteration of the functioning of the system, it is punishable by an

imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

When the act has resulted in either deletion or modification of the data contained in the system, or an alteration of the functioning of the system, it is punishable by an

imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 428: Act of Obstructing the Operations of Automated Data Processing System

heading: Article 433: Regicide
text:
Article 433: Regicide

Regicide is an assassination of the King. Regicide is punished to a life imprisonment.
translated_text:
Article 433: Regicide

Regicide is an assassination of the King. Regicide is punished by life imprisonment.

heading: Article 434: Tortures or Barbarous Acts Against the King
text:
Article 434: Tortures or Barbarous Acts Against the King

Tortures or barbarous acts against the King is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years.
translated_text:
Article 434: Tortures or Barbarous Acts Against the King

Tortures or barbarous acts against the King is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years.

heading: Article 435: Violence Against the King
text:
Article 435: Violence Against the King

The intentional commission of violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years.
translated_text:
Article 435: Violence Against the King

The intentional commission of violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years.

heading: Article 436: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Maiming or Disability
text:
Article 436: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting from in or Disability

Intentional violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (tweny) years when it has resulted in maiming or permanent disability of the King.
translated_text:
Article 436: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Maiming or Disability

Intentional violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years when it has resulted in maiming or permanent disability of the King.

heading: Article 437: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Death
text:
Article 437: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Death

Intentional violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 20 (twenty) years to 30 (thirty) years when it has resulted in a death without intention of so doing.
translated_text:
Article 437: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Death

heading: Article 438
CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE

SECTION 1 TREASON AND ESPIONAGE

Article 439: Treason and Espionage

The offences described in this Chapter constitute treason when they are committed by a Cambodian citizen or by Cambodian military person and constitute espionage, when they are committed by any other persons.

heading: Article 440: Delivering to a Foreign State Whole or Part of National Territory
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 440: Delivering to a Foreign State Whole or Part of National Territory

The act of delivering to a foreign state or to its agents whole or part of the national territory, is punishable by a life imprisonment.

heading: Article 442
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 442

Delivering to a Foreign State the Equipment especially for National Defence
The act of delivering to a foreign state or its agents the materials, buildings, equipment, installations, or mechanical apparatus for national defence, is punishable by an imprisonment from 15 (fifteen) years to 30 (thirty) years.

heading: Article 443: Espionage
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 443: Espionage

The acts of entering into secret agreement with a foreign state or with its agents in order to create hostilities or aggression against Cambodia is punishable by imprisonment from 15 (fifteen) years to 30 (thirty) years.

text:
Article 444

Provision of a Foreign State with Means of Undertaking Hostilities or Aggression
The acts of providing a foreign state or its agents with the means of undertaking the hostilities or aggressions against Cambodia, is punishable by an imprisonment from 15 (fifteen) years to 30 (thirty) years.

heading: Article 445
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 445

Provision of a Foreign State with Information which Undermines National Defence
The act of giving or facilitating easy access by a foreign state or its agents, to information, processes, objects, documents, data, information technologies or memorandum slip which undermine the national defence is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years.

heading: Article 446: Acts of Collecting Information which May Undermine National Defence
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 446: Acts of Collecting Information which May Undermine National Defence

The act of receiving or colleting with a view to delivering power to a foreign state or its agents the information, processes, objects, documents, data, information technologies or memorandum slip which may undermine national defence is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years.
translated_text:

heading: Article 447: Destruction of Materials which May Undermine National Defence
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 447: Destruction of Materials which May Undermine National Defence

The act of destroying, damaging or embezzling any documents, materials, buildings, equipment, installations, mechanical apparatus, technical device or the automated data processing system, or of producing some defect to them, when these acts undermine the national defence, is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years.

heading: Article 448: Provision of False Information
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 448: Provision of False Information

The act of providing, with a view to serve the interests of a foreign state, to the civilian or military authorities of Cambodia, false information which may undermine the national defence, is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a

fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 451: Criminal Attempt
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 451: Criminal Attempt

The acts of committing one or several acts of violence with a view to endanger the institutions of the Kingdom of Cambodia or to undermine the integrity of the national territory constitute a criminal attempt.

The criminal attempt is punishable by an imprisonment from 15 (fifteen) years to 30 (thirty) years.
translated_text:

heading: Article 452: Aggravating Circumstances With Regard to Offenders
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 452: Aggravating Circumstances With Regard to Offenders

The criminal attempt is punished to an imprisonment for life, when it is committed by a civil servant.

heading: Article 453: Conspiracy
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 453: Conspiracy

Any scheme set up between several persons to commit a criminal attempt, and this scheme was materialized by one or several concrete actions, constitutes a conspiracy.

Conspiracy is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years.

The offence is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years when it is committed by civil servants.
translated_text:

heading: Article 454: Exemption from Penalty
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 454: Exemption from Penalty

Any person having participated in a conspiracy is exempted from penalty if, before any prosecution, he/she has revealed to the competent authorities the existence of the conspiracy and thereby permitting the identification of other participants.

heading: Article 458: Aggravating Circumstances of Insurrection
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 458: Aggravating Circumstances of Insurrection

The act of participating in the movement of insurrection is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years:
1.	by seizing by force, weapons, munitions, explosives or any other substance dangerous to persons;
2.	by providing the insurgents with weapons, ammunitions, explosives or the substances dangerous to the persons.

heading: Article 477: Principle of Secrecy Protection of National Defence
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 477: Principle of Secrecy Protection of National Defence

The information, processes, objects, documents, memorandum slip or computerized data whose divulgence is susceptible to undermine the national defence may become the subject of protective measures intended to restrict their dissemination.

The modalities of organization of these protective measures are established by the Royal Government.
translated_text:
Article 477: Principle of Secrecy Protection of National Defence

The modalities of organization of these protective measures are established by the Royal Government.

heading: Article 478: Definition of Secrecy of National Defence
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 478: Definition of Secrecy of National Defence

The information, the processes, the objects, the documents, the memorandum slips or the computerized data whose divulgence is restricted constitutes the secrecy of the National Defence.
translated_text:
Article 478: Definition of Secrecy of National Defence

heading: Article 479: Intentional or Unintentional Revealing the Secrecy of National Defence
heading_path: CHAPTER 2 INFRINGEMENTS ON SECURITY OF THE STATE
text:
Article 479: Intentional or Unintentional Revealing the Secrecy of National Defence

Any person who holds, because of his/her status, of his/her profession or his/her mission, information, a process, an object, a document, a memorandum slip or computerized data which constitutes secrecy of the national defence is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels, if this person has revealed this secrecy to an unauthorized person.

Infringement of secrecy of the national defence caused by negligence, carelessness or disobedience is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (million) Riels.

heading: Article 488
text:
Article 488

Producing or Trafficking Weapons, Explosives or Similar Objects Production, importation, exportation and stocking of weapons, all kind of ammunitions and explosives, without authorization from competent authorities is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years.

Weapons refer to all kinds of guns that are produced or modified or assembled with which killing or injuring or damaging properties can be carried out.

All kinds of ammunitions and explosives refer to equipment or materials that are produced or modified with which killing or injuring or damaging properties can be carried.

All kinds of chemical weapons, biological weapons or other ammunitions containing chemical and biological substances refer to substances that are produced or modified or assembled to endanger health, life or properties and environment.

heading: Article 489: Production or Trafficking of other Assaulting Weapons
text:
Article 489: Production or Trafficking of other Assaulting Weapons

Production, importation, exportation and stocking of other assaulting weapons such as bayonets or brass knuckles for killing or injuring without authorization from competent authorities is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 490: Carrying or Transporting Weapons without Authorization
text:
Article 490: Carrying or Transporting Weapons without Authorization

Any person, outside of his/her residence, carries or transports, without authorization from competent authorities, a weapon, the ammunition or an explosive device is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 3 (three) years and a fine from

1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

Any person, outside of his/her residence, carries or transports a weapon falling into the scope of enforcement of Article 500 (Production or Trafficking of other Assaulting Weapons) is punishable by the same penalties.

heading: Article 491: Abandoning of Weapons in Public Places
text:
Article 491: Abandoning of Weapons in Public Places

The acts of abandoning in public place or a place that is accessible by the public a weapon or any other object that presents a danger to persons is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 3 (three) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

Article 495: Provocation to Commit Crimes
text:
Article 495: Provocation to Commit Crimes

The act of direct provocation aimed at committing a felony by one of the means specified in Article 503 (Conditions for Existence of Provocation) is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels, if the provocation produced no effect.

heading: Article 496: Provocation to Commit Discrimination
text:
Article 496: Provocation to Commit Discrimination

The act of direct provocation, by one of the means specified in Article 494 (Conditions for Existence of Provocation), hinting a discrimination, malice or violence against a person or a group of persons because of their belonging to or non-belonging to an ethnicity, a nationality, a race or a specific religion, is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels if the provocation produced no effect.

heading: Article 498
SECTION 4 MALEFACTOR COMMUNITY
text:
SECTION 4 MALEFACTOR COMMUNITY

Article 499: Elements of Malefactor Community and Penalties to be Imposed

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels for the acts of participating in a group or a knock-out agreement established in order to:
1.	commit one or many felonies against the persons specified in Chapter 1 on Unintentional Infringement on Life to Chapter 6 on Infringement on Privacy in Title 2 on Infringement on Human Life of Book 2 on Crime Against Privacy of this Code.
2.	commit one or many felonies against properties specified in Book 3 of the present Code;

heading: Article 500: Exemption from Penalties
text:
Article 500: Exemption from Penalties

The person is exempted from the penalty when he/she, having participated in the group or a knock-out agreement, and before any prosecution could take place, has revealed the competent authorities the group or the knock-out agreement and thus lead to the identification of other perpetrators.

heading: Article 502: Elements of Insult and Penalties to be Imposed
text:
Article 502: Elements of Insult and Penalties to be Imposed

The use of words, gestures, writings, sketches or objects which undermine the dignity of a person constitutes an insult.

The insult directed against a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandate by an election in office or in the occasion of performing his/her function is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) day to 6 (six) days and a fine from 1,000 (one thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 503: Elements of Rebellion and Penalties to be Imposed
text:
Article 503: Elements of Rebellion and Penalties to be Imposed

The acts of opposing with violent resistance against a public official who acts in order to enforce laws and orders of public authorities or the decisions of the court constitute rebellion.

The rebellion is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.
translated_text:

heading: Article 504: Aggravating Circumstances of Rebellions
text:
Article 504: Aggravating Circumstances of Rebellions

Rebellions are punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 1 (one) year and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels, in the following cases:
1.	it is committed by several persons acting in their capacity as perpetrator, co-perpetrators, instigator or accomplice;
2.	the perpetrator carried a weapon.

heading: Article 505: Inciting to Commit Rebellions
text:
Article 505: Inciting to Commit Rebellions

A direct inciting leading to the commission of rebellion is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) day to 1 (one) month and a fine from 1,000 (one thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 506: Obstruction against the Implementation of Public Works
text:
Article 506: Obstruction against the Implementation of Public Works

The act of obstructing by violence against the implementation of public works or the works for the interests of the public is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 507
CHAPTER 5 INFRINGEMENT ON STATE RELIGION
text:
CHAPTER 5 INFRINGEMENT ON STATE RELIGION

SECTION 1 OFFENCE AGAINST BUDDHISM

Article 508: Celebration of Buddhist Ceremony without Authorization

According to Article 43 of the Constitution, Buddhism is the religion of the state.

The acts of celebrating, in a religious premise open to the public, a Buddhist ceremony without having been authorized by a religious authority are punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

The act of wearing clothes in public where he/she is not entitled to wear such clothes for religious affairs is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Rield to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 509: Theft of Object Dedicated to Buddhism
text:
Article 509: Theft of Object Dedicated to Buddhism

Without prejudice to the most severe penalties instituted by the present code, the theft of an object dedicated to Buddhism committed in a religious premise is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 510: Damaging Religious Premise or Dedicated Objects
text:
Article 510: Damaging Religious Premise or Dedicated Objects

Without prejudice to the most severe penalties instituted by the present code, the act of intentional commission to destroy, damage or deteriorate a religious premise dedicated to Buddhism or an object dedicated to this religion is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

Article 513: Intentional Violence

The act of intentional violence against Buddhist monks and nuns or laymen are punishable from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 514
text:
Article 514

Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Maiming and Disability Intentional violence against Buddhist monks and nuns or laymen is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years when it entails a maiming or a permanent disability.

text:
Article 515: Aggravating Circumstances Resulting in Death of Victim

Intentional violence against Buddhist monks and nuns or laymen is punishable by an imprisonment from 10 (ten) years to 20 (twenty) years when it results in the death of the victim without any intention of so doing.

When insulting specified in Paragraph 1 of Article 502 (Elements of Insult and Penalties to be Imposed) of this Code is committed against Buddhist monks, nuns, laymen during the performance of their functions or during the course of performance of their functions, it is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) day to 6 (six) days and a fine from 1,000 (one thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 517: Briberies Committed by a Judge
text:
Article 517: Briberies Committed by a Judge

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 7 (seven) years to 15 (fifteen) years, for the act of any judge who, without any right, solicits or accepts either directly or indirectly any donation, present, promise or any interest:
1.	to fulfil any act in his/her function;
2.	or not to fulfil any act in his/her function.
translated_text:

2.	or not to fulfil any act in his/her function.

heading: Article 518: Briberies Given to a Judge
text:
Article 518: Briberies Given to a Judge

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years, for the act of any person who, without any right, gives either directly or indirectly, any donation, present, promise or any interest to a judge so that the judge:
1.	fulfil any act in his/her function;
2.	or not fulfil any act in his/her function.

heading: Article 519: Criminal responsibilities of Legal Entity (new article)
text:
Article 519: Criminal responsibilities of Legal Entity (new article)

Article 528: Intimidation against a Judge or a Lawyer

Any act of intimidation against a judge or a lawyer to influence over his/her behaviour in the exercise of his/her functions is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years, and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten) million Riels.

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years if this offence produces an effect.

heading: Article 529: Insulting a Judge
text:
Article 529: Insulting a Judge

from 1 (one) month to 3 (three) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 530: Interference in the Performance of Functions of the Court
text:
Article 530: Interference in the Performance of Functions of the Court

Any act of a public servant, a soldier or citizen receiving public mandates through an election who interferes in the performance of function of the court is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 530: Interference in the Performance of Functions of the Court

heading: Article 520: Refusal to Enforce the Court Decision
text:
Article 520: Refusal to Enforce the Court Decision

Any act of a public civil servant or a soldier in office who refuses to enforce the decision or judgement or order of the court authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 520: Refusal to Enforce the Court Decision

heading: Article 521: Issuing Unlawful Order to Detain or Release
text:
Article 521: Issuing Unlawful Order to Detain or Release

Any act under whatever form of a public civil servant, a soldier or a citizen receiving public mandates through an election, who issues an order to detain or release a detainee is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years.
translated_text:
Article 521: Issuing Unlawful Order to Detain or Release

heading: Article 522: Publication of any Commentaries to Put Pressure on Jurisdiction
text:
Article 522: Publication of any Commentaries to Put Pressure on Jurisdiction

Any publication, prior to the final decision of the court, of any commentaries aiming at putting pressure on the court where a law suit is filed, in order to influence over the decision of the court is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months, and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 522: Publication of any Commentaries to Put Pressure on Jurisdiction

Any publication, prior to the final decision of the court, of any commentaries aiming at putting pressure on the court where a law suit is filed, in order to influence over the decision of the court is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months, and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.

heading: Article 523: Discrediting the Court Decision
text:
Article 523: Discrediting the Court Decision

Any act of criticizing a letter or a court decision aiming at creating disturbance of public orders or endangering institutions of the Kingdom of Cambodia is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.

Failure to enforce the decision of the court is punishable by the same penalties specified in Paragraph 1 above.
translated_text:
Article 523: Discrediting the Court Decision

Failure to enforce the decision of the court is punishable by the same penalties specified in Paragraph 1 above.

heading: Article 524: Denunciation with Lies to the Court Authority
text:
Article 524: Denunciation with Lies to the Court Authority

Any act of denunciation by lying to the court or administrative authority of a fact

constituting an offence, when such act leads to a useless investigation is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months, and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 524: Denunciation with Lies to the Court Authority

Any act of denunciation by lying to the court or administrative authority of a fact

constituting an offence, when such act leads to a useless investigation is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months, and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.

heading: Article 525: Attempt
text:
Article 525: Attempt

The attempt to commit misdemeanours specified Article 520 (Interference in the Performance of Functions of the Court) and Article 524 (Denunciation with Lies to the Court Authority) of this Code carries the same punishment as misdemeanours.
translated_text:
Article 525: Attempt

The attempt to commit misdemeanours specified Article 520 (Interference in the Performance of Functions of the Court) and Article 524 (Denunciation with Lies to the Court Authority) of this Code carries the same punishment as misdemeanours.

heading: Article 527: Intimidation to not File a Complaint
text:
Article 527: Intimidation to not File a Complaint

Any act of intimidation and threat to incite the victim not to file a complaint or to withdraw his/her complaint is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years, and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels if this offence produces an effect.
translated_text:

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels if this offence produces an effect.

heading: Article 528: Failure to File Complaint of a Felony or Misdemeanour by a Public Agent
text:
Article 528: Failure to File Complaint of a Felony or Misdemeanour by a Public Agent

Any act of a public servant, a soldier or citizen receiving public mandates through an election who fails to complain to the court authority of the felony or misdemeanour which he/she has known while in office or during the performance of his/her functions is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 528: Failure to File Complaint of a Felony or Misdemeanour by a Public Agent

Any act of a public servant, a soldier or citizen receiving public mandates through an election who fails to complain to the court authority of the felony or misdemeanour which he/she has known while in office or during the performance of his/her functions is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 529
text:
Article 529

Suppression and Exemption of Penalties for Failure to Complaint about a Felony
Any person who has knowledge of a felony which can be prevented or reduced its

effects but fails to complaint it to the court authority or administrative authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.
However, punishment is exempted for:
1.	ascendant and descendant, brothers and sisters of the perpetrator, co-perpetrators, instigator, or accomplice;
2.	a spouse of the perpetrator, co-perpetrators, instigator, or accomplice;
3.	a person who is required by a law to maintain the confidentiality of the profession.

Article 529

3.	a person who is required by a law to maintain the confidentiality of the profession.

heading: Article 530: Failure to Complaint about Mistreatment of a Minor
text:
Article 530: Failure to Complaint about Mistreatment of a Minor

Any person who has knowledge of mistreatment or sexual abuse against a minor of less than 15 (fifteen) years of age, but fails to inform the court or administrative authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 530: Failure to Complaint about Mistreatment of a Minor

heading: Article 531: Hiding a Dead Body
text:
Article 531: Hiding a Dead Body

Any act of disappearing or hiding a dead body of any victim of a homicide or a violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 531: Hiding a Dead Body

Any act of disappearing or hiding a dead body of any victim of a homicide or a violence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 532: Hiding Leads
text:
Article 532: Hiding Leads

Any act of modifying or disappearing leads or marks at a scene of felony or misdemeanour with the purpose of creating obstacles to finding facts is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 532: Hiding Leads

Any act of modifying or disappearing leads or marks at a scene of felony or misdemeanour with the purpose of creating obstacles to finding facts is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 533: Disappearing Evidence
text:
Article 533: Disappearing Evidence

Any act of disappearing or moving or taking away any object at a scene of felony or misdemeanour with the purpose of creating obstacles to finding facts is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 533: Disappearing Evidence

Any act of disappearing or moving or taking away any object at a scene of felony or misdemeanour with the purpose of creating obstacles to finding facts is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 534: Destruction of Documents
text:
Article 534: Destruction of Documents

Any intentional act of destroying, stealing, or modifying a document or an object which

may facilitate the discovery of a felony or misdemeanour, the identification or the arrest of a perpetrator is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 534: Destruction of Documents

Any intentional act of destroying, stealing, or modifying a document or an object which

may facilitate the discovery of a felony or misdemeanour, the identification or the arrest of a perpetrator is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 535: Breaking Seals
text:
Article 535: Breaking Seals

Any act of breaking seals affixed by a competent authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 535: Breaking Seals

Any act of breaking seals affixed by a competent authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 536: Destruction or Disappearance of Objects Affixed with Seals
text:
Article 536: Destruction or Disappearance of Objects Affixed with Seals

Any act of destroying or disappearing objects affixed with the seals made by a competent authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 536: Destruction or Disappearance of Objects Affixed with Seals

Any act of destroying or disappearing objects affixed with the seals made by a competent authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 537: Refusal to Give Answers
text:
Article 537: Refusal to Give Answers

Any person who declared publicly that he/she knows the perpetrator, co-perpetrators, instigator or accomplice of a felony or misdemeanour and refuses to answer the questions posed to him/her about the case by a judge is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 537: Refusal to Give Answers

Any person who declared publicly that he/she knows the perpetrator, co-perpetrators, instigator or accomplice of a felony or misdemeanour and refuses to answer the questions posed to him/her about the case by a judge is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.

heading: Article 538: Refusal to Appear
text:
Article 538: Refusal to Appear

Any person who is summoned to testify as witness before a prosecutor or an investigating judge or a criminal court and refuses to appear himself/herself following the summon without any valid reason is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 538: Refusal to Appear

Any person who is summoned to testify as witness before a prosecutor or an investigating judge or a criminal court and refuses to appear himself/herself following the summon without any valid reason is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.

heading: Article 539: Penalties and Exemption
Article 540: Using Identity of Others
text:
Article 540: Using Identity of Others

Any act of taking the name of the third person under the circumstance which leads to a criminal prosecution against the third person or which may lead to a criminal prosecution against the third person is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 540: Using Identity of Others

Any act of taking the name of the third person under the circumstance which leads to a criminal prosecution against the third person or which may lead to a criminal prosecution against the third person is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 541: Refusal to Follow Order
text:
Article 541: Refusal to Follow Order

The driver of any vehicle who refuses to follow the order to stop issued by a police or a gendarmerie officer wearing a police or gendarmeries emblem to search for evidence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 10,000 (ten thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 541: Refusal to Follow Order

The driver of any vehicle who refuses to follow the order to stop issued by a police or a gendarmerie officer wearing a police or gendarmeries emblem to search for evidence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 10,000 (ten thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 542: Refusal by a Driver to be Examined
text:
Article 542: Refusal by a Driver to be Examined

The driver of any vehicle who refuses to submit himself/herself or his/her vehicle for examination carried out by a police or gendarmerie officer wearing a police or gendarmeries emblem to search for evidence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 10,000 (ten thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.
.

Article 542: Refusal by a Driver to be Examined

The driver of any vehicle who refuses to submit himself/herself or his/her vehicle for examination carried out by a police or gendarmerie officer wearing a police or gendarmeries emblem to search for evidence is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 3 (three) months and a fine from 10,000 (ten thousand) Riels to 500,000 (five hundred thousand) Riels.

heading: Article 543: Definition of Evasion and Penalties
text:
Article 543: Definition of Evasion and Penalties

The act committed by a driver of a land, river or maritime vehicle who has clear knowledge that he/she has just provoked an accident or a damage but fails to stop in order to evade from the criminal or civil responsibility which may be imposed on him/ her is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 543: Definition of Evasion and Penalties

The act committed by a driver of a land, river or maritime vehicle who has clear knowledge that he/she has just provoked an accident or a damage but fails to stop in order to evade from the criminal or civil responsibility which may be imposed on him/ her is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) months to 2 (two) years and a fine from 1,000,000 (one million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 544
Article 545 : Peines et exemption pour faux témoignages
text:
Article 545: Penalties and Exemption for False Testimonies

False testimonies made after taking an oath before the court or a judicial police officer who acts under the framework of a rogation commission order is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

A liar witness is exempted from punishment, if he/she has spontaneously retracted his/her testimony and only speaks the truth before the decision to terminate the inquiry or trial procedures is taken.
translated_text:
Article 545 : Peines et exemption pour faux témoignages

Les faux témoignages faits après avoir prêté serment devant le tribunal ou un officier de police judiciaire qui agit dans le cadre d'une commission rogatoire sont punis d'un emprisonnement de 2 (deux) ans à 5 (cinq) ans et d'une amende de 4.000.000 (quatre millions) de riels à 10.000.000 (dix millions) de riels.

Un témoin menteur est exempté de peine, s'il s'est spontanément rétracté de son témoignage et ne dit que la vérité avant que la décision de clore l'enquête ou la procédure de jugement ne soit prise.

heading: Article 546 : Intimidation contre un témoin
text:
Article 546: Intimidation Against a Witness

Any act of intimidation committed by a perpetrator alone or with consent of a third party to instigate a witness not to give any statement or to provide false oral or written testimony is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years if the offence produces an effect.
translated_text:
Article 546 : Intimidation contre un témoin

Tout acte d'intimidation commis par un auteur seul ou avec le consentement d'un tiers pour inciter un témoin à ne faire aucune déclaration ou à fournir un faux témoignage oral ou écrit est puni d'un emprisonnement de 2 (deux) ans à 5 (cinq) ans et d'une amende de 4.000.000 (quatre millions) de riels à 10.000.000 (dix millions) de riels.

Il est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans si l'infraction produit un effet.

heading: Article 547 : Corruption reçue par un témoin pour produire de faux témoignages
text:
Article 547: Bribery Taken by a Witness to Produce False Testimonies

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years for the act of any witness who directly or indirectly solicits or accept donation, present, promise or any interest in order:
1.	not to testify as a witness;
2.	to provide false testimony.
translated_text:
Article 547 : Corruption reçue par un témoin pour produire de faux témoignages

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans l'acte de tout témoin qui sollicite ou accepte directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt afin de :
1.	ne pas témoigner en tant que témoin ;
2.	fournir un faux témoignage.

heading: Article 548 : Corruption donnée à un témoin
text:
Article 548: Bribery Given to a Witness

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years any person who gives directly or indirectly donation, present, promise or any interest to a witness in order:
1.	not to testify as a witness;
2.	to provide false testimony.
translated_text:
Article 548 : Corruption donnée à un témoin

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans toute personne qui donne directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt à un témoin afin de :
1.	ne pas témoigner en tant que témoin ;
2.	fournir un faux témoignage.

heading: Article 549 : Publication visant à faire pression sur un témoin
text:
Article 549: Publication Aiming at Putting Pressure on a Witness

Any publication, prior to the final decision of the court, of any commentaries which intends to put pressure on a witness in order to influence over the testimony of the witness is punishable by an imprisonment from 6 (six) days to 1 (one) month and a fine from 10,000 (ten thousand) Riels to 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 549 : Publication visant à faire pression sur un témoin

Toute publication, avant la décision finale du tribunal, de commentaires qui visent à faire pression sur un témoin afin d'influencer le témoignage du témoin est punie d'un emprisonnement de 6 (six) jours à 1 (un) mois et d'une amende de 10.000 (dix mille) riels à 100.000 (cent mille) riels.

heading: SECTION 3 TRADUCTION/INTERPRÉTATION ET EXAMEN MÉDICO-LÉGAL
text:
SECTION 3 TRANSLATION/INTERPRETATION AND FORENSIC EXAMINATION

Article 550: Perversion Committed by Interpreter/Translator

Any act of perversion intentionally committed by an interpreter/translator of the substance of the words or of the translated documents is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
SECTION 3 TRADUCTION/INTERPRÉTATION ET EXAMEN MÉDICO-LÉGAL

Article 550 : Perversion commise par un interprète/traducteur

Tout acte de perversion intentionnellement commis par un interprète/traducteur de la substance des paroles ou des documents traduits est puni d'un emprisonnement de 2 (deux) ans à 5 (cinq) ans et d'une amende de 4.000.000 (quatre millions) de riels à 10.000.000 (dix millions) de riels.

heading: Article 551 : Perversion commise par un expert
text:
Article 551: Perversion Committed by an Expert

Any act committed by an expert to falsify the written report or oral statement on data or result of a forensic examination is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 551 : Perversion commise par un expert

Tout acte commis par un expert pour falsifier le rapport écrit ou la déclaration orale sur les données ou le résultat d'un examen médico-légal est puni d'un emprisonnement de 2 (deux) ans à 5 (cinq) ans et d'une amende de 4.000.000 (quatre millions) de riels à 10.000.000 (dix millions) de riels.

heading: Article 552 : Intimidation contre un expert ou un traducteur/interprète
text:
Article 552: Intimidation against Expert or Translator/Interpreter

Any act of intimidation against an expert or a translator/interpreter in order to influence over his/her behaviour during the performance of his/her function is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) to 10 (ten) years if the offence produces an effect.
translated_text:
Article 552 : Intimidation contre un expert ou un traducteur/interprète

Tout acte d'intimidation contre un expert ou un traducteur/interprète afin d'influencer son comportement pendant l'exercice de sa fonction est puni d'un emprisonnement de 2 (deux) ans à 5 (cinq) ans et d'une amende de 4.000.000 (quatre millions) de riels à 10.000.000 (dix millions) de riels.

Il est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) à 10 (dix) ans si l'infraction produit un effet.

heading: Article 553 : Corruption commise par un interprète/traducteur
text:
Article 553: Bribery Committed by an Interpreter/Translator

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years for the act of any interpreter/translator who directly or indirectly solicits or accept donation, present, promise or any interest in order to pervert the substance of the words or the translation of the document.
translated_text:
Article 553 : Corruption commise par un interprète/traducteur

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans l'acte de tout interprète/traducteur qui sollicite ou accepte directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt afin de pervertir la substance des paroles ou la traduction du document.

heading: Article 554 : Corruption donnée à un interprète/traducteur
text:
Article 554: Bribery Given to an Interpreter/Translator

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years any person who gives directly or indirectly donation, present, promise or any interest to an interpreter/translator in order to pervert the substance of the words or the translation of the document.
translated_text:
Article 554 : Corruption donnée à un interprète/traducteur

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans toute personne qui donne directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt à un interprète/traducteur afin de pervertir la substance des paroles ou la traduction du document.

heading: Article 555 : Corruption commise par un expert
text:
Article 555: Bribery Committed by an Expert

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years for the act of any expert who directly or indirectly solicits or accept donation, present, promise or any interest in order to falsify the written report or oral statement on any data or result of a forensic examination.
translated_text:
Article 555 : Corruption commise par un expert

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans l'acte de tout expert qui sollicite ou accepte directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt afin de falsifier le rapport écrit ou la déclaration orale sur toute donnée ou résultat d'un examen médico-légal.

heading: Article 556 : Corruption donnée à un expert
text:
Article 556: Bribery Given to an Expert

It is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years any person who gives directly or indirectly donation, present, promise or any interest to an expert in order to falsify the written report or oral statement on any data or result of a forensic examination.
translated_text:
Article 556 : Corruption donnée à un expert

Est puni d'un emprisonnement de 5 (cinq) ans à 10 (dix) ans toute personne qui donne directement ou indirectement un don, un présent, une promesse ou tout intérêt à un expert afin de falsifier le rapport écrit ou la déclaration orale sur toute donnée ou résultat d'un examen médico-légal.

heading: SECTION 4
text:
SECTION 4

ATTEMPT AND ADDITIONAL PENALTIES
translated_text:
SECTION 4

TENTATIVE ET PEINES COMPLÉMENTAIRES

heading: Article 557 : Tentative
text:
Article 557: Attempt

The attempt to commit misdemeanours specified Article 527 (Intimidation to not File a Complaint) and Article 531 (Hiding a Dead Body), Article 536 (Destruction or Disappearance of Objects Affixed with Seals), Article 540 (Using Identity of Others) and Article 544 (Penalties and Exemption for Assistance to Perpetrator, Co Perpetrators, Instigator and Accomplice) of this Code carries the same punishment as misdemeanours.
translated_text:
Article 557 : Tentative

La tentative de commettre les délits spécifiés à l'article 527 (Intimidation pour ne pas déposer plainte) et à l'article 531 (Dissimulation d'un cadavre), à l'article 536 (Destruction ou disparition d'objets scellés), à l'article 540 (Usurpation d'identité d'autrui) et à l'article 544 (Peines et exemption pour l'assistance à l'auteur, coauteurs, instigateur et complice) du présent Code est punie de la même peine que les délits.

heading: Article 558
Article 559: Criminal Responsibilities of the Legal Entities
CHAPTER 3
text:
CHAPTER 3

OFFENCES WITH REGARD TO DETENTION
translated_text:
CHAPTER 3

OFFENCES WITH REGARD TO DETENTION

heading: SECTION 1 ELEMENTS OF ESCAPE
Article 561: Penalties to be Imposed
text:
Article 561: Penalties to be Imposed

Escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 561: Penalties to be Imposed

Escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 562: Acts Treated as Escape
text:
Article 562: Acts Treated as Escape

It is considered as an escape and is subjected to the same punishment for:
1.	any act of a detainee placed in a health or hospital establishment or other places such as court, police headquarters, who escaped from being under surveillance;
2.	any act of a convicted person who is benefiting from a regime of semi-freedom, suspension of sentence, or split of punishment or permission to go

outside the prison, and does not return to the prison at the expiration of the period of the freedom.
translated_text:
Article 562: Acts Treated as Escape

It is considered as an escape and is subjected to the same punishment for:
1.	any act of a detainee placed in a health or hospital establishment or other places such as court, police headquarters, who escaped from being under surveillance;
2.	any act of a convicted person who is benefiting from a regime of semi-freedom, suspension of sentence, or split of punishment or permission to go

outside the prison, and does not return to the prison at the expiration of the period of the freedom.

heading: SECTION 2
text:
SECTION 2

heading: Article 563: Intimidation by Weapon or by Concerted Activities
text:
Article 563: Intimidation by Weapon or by Concerted Activities

An escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels, if it is committed under the following circumstances:
1.	by a threat with a weapon or an explosive;
2.	in a framework of concerted activities between several detainees.
translated_text:
Article 563: Intimidation by Weapon or by Concerted Activities

An escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels, if it is committed under the following circumstances:
1.	by a threat with a weapon or an explosive;
2.	in a framework of concerted activities between several detainees.

heading: Article 564: Use of Weapon
text:
Article 564: Use of Weapon

An escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years, if a weapon or explosive was used.
translated_text:

heading: Article 565: Provision of Means for Escape
text:
Article 565: Provision of Means for Escape

Any act of providing a detainee with all means for escape or facilitating his/her escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 565: Provision of Means for Escape

heading: Article 566: Aggravating Circumstances Relating to the Provision of Means for Escape
text:
Article 566: Aggravating Circumstances Relating to the Provision of Means for Escape

Any act of providing the detainee with weapons or explosive substances or incendiary substances or poisonous substances or acid to be used as means or facilitating escape is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 566: Aggravating Circumstances Relating to the Provision of Means for Escape

heading: Article 567: Facilitation of Escape by a Guardian
text:
Article 567: Facilitation of Escape by a Guardian

An act by a person who has duty to guard and facilitates or prepares for an escape of a detainee, even if it is by a voluntary abstention is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years .

heading: Article 568
text:

years to 15 (fifteen) years.

heading: Article 571: Unlawful Delivery and Aggravating Circumstances
text:
Article 571: Unlawful Delivery and Aggravating Circumstances

An act of delivering or sending to a detainee of money, correspondence, an object or any substance, except that authorized by the regulations is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 1 (one) year and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 2,000,000 (two million) Riels.

The above offences are punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels if they are committed:
1.	by a person who is in charge of guardianship of the detainees;
2.	by a person who is authorized to enter the prison.

text:

heading: Article 574: Exemption from Penalties
text:
Article 574: Exemption from Penalties

Any person as perpetrator, co-perpetrator, instigator or accomplice who attempts to commit any offences specified in Article 561 (Penalties to be Imposed) and Article 563 (Intimidation by Weapon or by Concerted Activities) to Article 570 (Aggravating Circumstances Relating to Facilitation of Escape by a Person Authorized to Enter the Prison) is exempted from punishment, if he/she had informed it to an administrative or judicial authority in order to prevent the escape from materialized.

heading: Article 576: Violation on Prohibition against Taking Residency
text:
Article 576: Violation on Prohibition against Taking Residency

The act of a person who is prohibited against taking residency as prescribed by the court authority and appears at the place of prohibition is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 576: Violation on Prohibition against Taking Residency

The act of a person who is prohibited against taking residency as prescribed by the court authority and appears at the place of prohibition is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 577: Failure to Respect Surveillance Measures
text:
Article 577: Failure to Respect Surveillance Measures

Any act by a person who is prohibited against taking residency and evades himself/ herself from surveillance measure as prescribed by the court authority is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 577: Failure to Respect Surveillance Measures

heading: Article 578: Violation on Posting Penalty
text:
Article 578: Violation on Posting Penalty

In case that a sentence to post the decision of the court is pronounced, any act of disappearing, hiding or lacerating the poster is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) month to 6 (six) months and a fine from 100,000 (one hundred thousand) Riels to 1,000,000 (one million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 578: Violation on Posting Penalty

heading: Article 579: Violation on Prohibition Against Pursuing Profession
text:
Article 579: Violation on Prohibition Against Pursuing Profession

In case that a sentence to prohibit against pursuing a profession is pronounced, any act of violation of this prohibition is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 579: Violation on Prohibition Against Pursuing Profession

heading: Article 580: Violation on Penalty which Limits Certain Rights
text:
Article 580: Violation on Penalty which Limits Certain Rights

A violation by the convicted person of the obligations or prohibitions resulting from the punishment to suspension of driving-license, the prohibition against possessing or carrying a weapon, the prohibition against issuing checks, the closure of the establishment or expulsion from public market places is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 581: Failure to Respect Confiscation
text:
Article 581: Failure to Respect Confiscation

An act of destroying, hiding or dissimulating the confiscated object is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 581: Failure to Respect Confiscation

heading: Article 582: Refusal to Hand-Over Driver-Licence
text:
Article 582: Refusal to Hand-Over Driver-Licence

An act of refusing to hand-over the competent authorities a suspended driver- license or a confiscated object which fails to respect an effective court's decision is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 582: Refusal to Hand-Over Driver-Licence

An act of refusing to hand-over the competent authorities a suspended driver- license or a confiscated object which fails to respect an effective court's decision is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 583: Violation of Community Work Obligation
text:
Article 583: Violation of Community Work Obligation

A violation by the convicted person of the obligations resulting from the sentence to community work is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 583: Violation of Community Work Obligation

heading: Article 584: Violation of Obligations Pronounced Against Legal Entities
text:
Article 584: Violation of Obligations Pronounced Against Legal Entities

When an obligation or prohibition is pronounced on a legal entity, the violation by a natural person of this obligation or prohibition is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 598
text:
Article 598

Infringement on the Free Exercise of Rights to Vote and Aggravating Circumstances
Any act of violence, coercion, threat or fraudulent trick which affects the free exercise of the rights to vote or to the regularity of the election is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

This offence is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels, if a weapon was used during the commission the offence.
translated_text:
Article 598

This offence is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels, if a weapon was used during the commission the offence.

heading: Article 599: Propagating False Information to Prevent Voting
text:
Article 599: Propagating False Information to Prevent Voting

An act of propagating false information in order to prevent voters not to go to vote is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 599: Propagating False Information to Prevent Voting

An act of propagating false information in order to prevent voters not to go to vote is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 600: Participating in a Voting Without Eligibility
text:
Article 600: Participating in a Voting Without Eligibility

An act of a person who is not eligible to vote and participate in a voting is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 600: Participating in a Voting Without Eligibility

heading: Article 601: Participating in a Voting by Using False Identity
text:
Article 601: Participating in a Voting by Using False Identity

An act of participating in a voting by using a false identity is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 601: Participating in a Voting by Using False Identity

heading: Article 602: Instigating a Voter by a Candidate
text:
Article 602: Instigating a Voter by a Candidate

An act of a candidate to give any voter a gift or a present or an agreement to provide any interest in order to obtain a vote in his/her favour is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years.
translated_text:
Article 602: Instigating a Voter by a Candidate

heading: Article 603
text:
Article 603

Manipulating the Result of an Election by a Person in Charge of Vote Counting
An act of manipulating the result of an election, by whatever means, committed by any person who is in charge of vote counting or election supervising is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 603

Manipulating the Result of an Election by a Person in Charge of Vote Counting

heading: Article 604: Intimidation Against Members of a Polling Station
text:
Article 604: Intimidation Against Members of a Polling Station

Any act of intimidation against any member of a polling station in order to influence his/her behaviour during the performance of his/her function is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 604: Intimidation Against Members of a Polling Station

heading: Article 605
text:
Article 605

Manipulating the Result of an Election by a Person in Charge of Vote Counting
Without prejudice to more severe penalties as prescribed by this Code, the intentional violence against any member of a polling station is punishable by an imprisonment from
2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 606: Attempt
text:
Article 606: Attempt

heading: Article 607
Article 608: Stealing of a Ballot Box
text:
Article 608: Stealing of a Ballot Box

Without prejudice to more severe penalties as prescribed by this Code, the stealing of a ballot box containing ballots therein is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 608: Stealing of a Ballot Box

heading: Article 609: Destroying or Damaging a Ballot Box
text:
Article 609: Destroying or Damaging a Ballot Box

Without prejudice to more severe penalties as prescribed by this Code, any act committed intentionally to destroy, or damage or deteriorate any ballot box containing ballots therein is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 609: Destroying or Damaging a Ballot Box

heading: SECTION 1 DISOBEDIENCE OF DUTIES

SECTION 1 DISOBEDIENCE OF DUTIES

Sub-Section 1 Abuse of Power

Article 586: Taking Measures to Prevent Law Enforcement and Aggravating Circumstances

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election in office or during the performance of his/her function to take measures to prevent law enforcement is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten

million) Riels.

This offence is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years if it produces an effect.

This offence is punishable by an imprisonment from 5 (five) years to 10 (ten) years if it produces an effect.

heading: Article 587: Unlawful Continuation to Perform Functions
text:
Article 587: Unlawful Continuation to Perform Functions

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election to continue to perform his/her functions when this functions is terminated is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 2 (two) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 4,000,000 (four million) Riels.

heading: Article 588: Infringement on Freedom of Individuals
text:
Article 588: Infringement on Freedom of Individuals

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election in office or during the performance of his/her function to unlawfully continue the performance of tasks which affect the freedom of individual is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 588: Infringement on Freedom of Individuals

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election in office or during the performance of his/her function to unlawfully continue the performance of tasks which affect the freedom of individual is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.

heading: Article 589: Refusal to Release a Person who is Unlawfully Detained
text:
Article 589: Refusal to Release a Person who is Unlawfully Detained

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election in office or during the performance of his/her function to unlawfully deprive freedom and intentionally refuse to terminate this deprivation while he/she has the authorities to terminate the deprivation of this freedom or fails to request for interventions from competent authorities is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.
translated_text:
Article 589: Refusal to Release a Person who is Unlawfully Detained

The acts committed by a civil servant or a citizen entrusted with public mandates through an election in office or during the performance of his/her function to unlawfully deprive freedom and intentionally refuse to terminate this deprivation while he/she has the authorities to terminate the deprivation of this freedom or fails to request for interventions from competent authorities is punishable by an imprisonment from 1 (one) year to 3 (three) years and a fine from 2,000,000 (two million) Riels to 6,000,000 (six million) Riels.

heading: Article 590: Unlawful Detention or Release
text:
Article 590: Unlawful Detention or Release

The act of a prison administration agent to detain or release a person without a warrant, a judgement or an order for detention or release issued in accordance with the law is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
translated_text:

heading: Article 591: Prolongation of Unlawful Detention
text:
Article 591: Prolongation of Unlawful Detention

The act of a prison administration agent to unlawfully prolong a detention is punishable by an imprisonment from 2 (two) years to 5 (five) years and a fine from 4,000,000 (four million) Riels to 10,000,000 (ten million) Riels.
